title: Add Compose No Ui Dependency Policy
description: Add a new compose policy with a NoUiDependency statute (not autofixable). Check that all compose.* files are self-contained and don't import from any UI dependency. Examples: compose.ts imports from tailwind-merge, compose.test.ts imports from elements/ui.
summary: Added new "compose" policy with BreachComposeNoUiDependency statute (not autofixable, HIGH priority). The statute checks that all compose.* files are self-contained and do not import UI dependencies (clsx, tailwind-merge, three, react, elements/ui, etc.). Added 10 comprehensive tests. Also fixed case-sensitivity bug in GraphQL Policy resolver.
